ai_review.summary: Stellar, evenly balanced recording that captures a favorite Sailor Saint performance and superb overall energy.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the pristine mix – all instruments and vocals are clear and evenly balanced – making this an exceptional listening experience. The show itself is highlighted by a killer rendition of “Sailor Saint,” with Bob Weir delivering one of his best performances, and the band’s energy staying high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and praise both the musical performance and the recording quality; limited number of reviews reduces confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix described as stellar with all instruments and vocals present, evenly balanced, and clear throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set details provided, but the overall vibe is highly praised and described as a favorite show.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) is noted as being at his best during Sailor Saint.
